第 39 章 Help Yourself to Better One-on-Ones帮自己获得更好的一对一

Vrashabh Irde / 弗拉沙布·伊尔迪

— 第 118 页 —

One-on-one meetings are a critical part of running healthy engineering teams. For engineering managers, they're the most important meetings of the week—uncancellable time slots dedicated to listening to engineers on their teams. Although there is a lot of literature on the internet about how to run good one-on-ones for managers, there seems to be little emphasis on the fact that one-on-one meetings are actually engineer driven. The time set aside every week is your opportunity as an engineer to broach critical topics for conversation. Here are some tips on how you as an engineer can make these conversations valuable, help your manager better recognize their value, and help yourself to perform better.

一对一是运营健康工程团队的关键部分。对工程经理来说，它们是一周中最重要的会议——不可取消的时间段，专门用来倾听团队工程师。虽然网上有很多关于经理怎么做好一对一的资料，但似乎很少强调一对一其实是工程师驱动的。每周留出的时间是你作为工程师提出关键话题讨论的机会。以下是一些技巧，教你作为工程师如何让这些对话有价值、帮你的经理更好认识它们的价值、帮自己表现更好。

Bring an Agenda带议程来

I cannot stress this enough. As with any meeting, it's important to come to a one-on-one with a preplanned agenda. A good way to do this is to maintain a shared Google Docs file with your manager and prepopulate it with the agenda that you want to address in the next meeting. As you go through your week, add to this file the things that you want to discuss so you don't need to scour for topics at the last minute. If it's still empty before your next one-on-one, maybe it's a great opportunity to talk about career progression, growth, and giving feedback to your manager. Which brings us to…

我怎么强调都不为过。和任何会议一样，带着预先计划的议程来一对一很重要。一个好方式是和经理维护一个共享 Google Docs 文件，预填你想在下次会议讨论的议程。一周中随时往这个文件里加你想讨论的事情，这样最后一分钟不用找话题。如果下次一对一时它还是空的，也许是个好机会聊聊职业发展、成长、以及给经理反馈。这就把我们带到了……

Talk About and Build Career Goals谈论和建立职业目标

One-on-one meetings are the perfect time to bring up any skills that you want to improve on, new things you want to learn about, or a new role that you aspire to grow into. Your manager likely already knows about various opportunities in the company of which you're not aware. Making your career and skills growth a regular part of your one-on-ones are more likely to pair you with any new career opportunities that might arise.

一对一是提出你想提升的技能、想学的新东西、或你渴望成长到的新角色的完美时机。你的经理可能已经知道公司里你不知道的各种机会。把职业和技能成长变成一对一的常规部分，更可能让你和可能出现的新职业机会配对。

— 第 119 页 —

It also creates an opportunity for you to document regular progress between review cycles and learn how to get to where you want to go. Harvard research says that best way to stay motivated at work is by achieving and documenting small wins, and one-on-ones are a great place to do that. However, although this is important, one-on-ones are a great place to just talk about how you feel.

它还为你创造了在评估周期之间记录常规进展的机会，学习怎么到达你想去的地方。哈佛研究说在工作中保持动力的最好方式是取得和记录小胜利，一对一就是做这件事的好地方。然而虽然这很重要，一对一也是聊聊你感受的好地方。

Talk About How You Are Feeling聊聊你的感受

Tech companies and startups are a cauldron of difficult conversations, deadlines, stressful situations, and politics and can have a strong impact on the mental state of individuals. One-on-ones generally are misconstrued as a place for doing status updates. This is certainly not the norm, and I generally recommend for my engineers to open up about their mental state and how they are feeling about the work they are doing, the environment they're in and the future as they see it. As engineers, you have the freedom to pick up any discussion, put it on the agenda and talk about it during the meeting. The one-on-one is meant to be a safe space for discussions. These crucial conversations help your manager make recommendations and set you up for success in your career. It can also help your manager detect burnout and put plans in place to help you.

科技公司和创业公司是艰难对话、截止日期、压力情境和办公室政治的大锅，会对个人的精神状态产生强烈影响。一对一通常被误解为做状态更新的地方。这当然不是常态，我通常建议我的工程师敞开心扉聊聊他们的精神状态、他们对正在做的工作、所处环境和他们看到的未来的感受。作为工程师，你有自由挑选任何讨论、放到议程上、在会议中谈。一对一本意就是讨论的安全空间。这些关键对话帮你的经理给出建议、为你的职业成功铺路。它还能帮你的经理发现倦怠并制定计划帮你。

Agree on a Format就格式达成一致

Although some one-on-ones can be just conversations without structure, I generally recommend agreeing on a format with your manager on how to structure them. I've seen success by structuring 20 minutes of every one-on-one conversation to focus on the agenda and the next 10 minutes focused on career conversations. Structure allows for conversations to be focused.

虽然有些一对一可以只是没有结构的对话，我通常建议和经理就如何结构化达成一致。我见过成功的做法是把每次一对一的 20 分钟聚焦议程，接下来的 10 分钟聚焦职业对话。结构让对话更聚焦。

Hold Your Manager Accountable让你的经理负责

It's important to follow up on actions and discussions that happen in one-on-ones. Engineering managers generally have a lot going on, so it's very useful if you as an engineer take the initiative to make sure actions are followed up on and the proper conversations are had. Capturing one-on-one conversations in a Google Docs file like I mentioned before is one way to make sure this happens, and it helps to hold your manager accountable if there are any follow-ups.

跟进一对一中发生的行动和讨论很重要。工程经理通常有很多事，所以如果你作为工程师主动确保行动被跟进、适当的对话被进行，这非常有用。像我之前提到的在 Google Docs 文件中记录一对一是确保这一点的一种方式，如果有跟进事项也有助于让你的经理负责。

— 第 120 页 —

Give Feedback给反馈

One-on-ones are not a one-way street. When you show a little empathy and accommodation for your manager, it makes them more likely to want to do the same for you. A great way to do that is to provide feedback. It builds trust, which is an invaluable capital to have with your manager and management team. Effective one-on-one meetings are a two-way street. Take a few minutes to talk about ways you can help them, and you're more likely to get what you want, too.

一对一不是单行道。当你对经理表现出一点共情和体谅时，他们更可能也想对你这么做。一个好方式是提供反馈。它建立信任，这是你和经理及管理团队之间宝贵的资本。有效的一对一是双向的。花几分钟谈谈你可以怎么帮他们，你也更可能得到你想要的。

Push Back Hard Against Cancellation/Postponing强烈反对取消/推迟

Good engineering managers will always prioritize one-on-one conversations over any other meetings in their calendar. Hold them to this and try to make it to every one-on-one that has been scheduled. If they need to cancel for any reason, it's ok to ask them why and make sure it gets rescheduled.

好的工程经理总会把一对一对话优先于日历上任何其他会议。要求他们做到这一点，尽量参加每一个安排好的一对一。如果他们因为任何原因需要取消，可以问他们为什么并确保重新安排。
